No production creator binds expectedCampaignId in Task 13 (CampaignCoopEntryPanel, this component's two connect calls and the mission launch page connect unbound) and server.js composes no applicationReceipts, so production joins keep lastSeq and the legacy numeric observation ACK
legacyVisibleChange: One, by design (registration review note 6, P2CF1 review CF1): the host fold resets to EMPTY on every binding, so a roomCode or matchId change without unmounting quotes no cursor and adopts the hydration baseline at 0 instead of refusing it against the old binding's cursor.
